rationale: Caps the first reverse-tail recurrence pass to 0.86 at final eval and as the late schedule target, preserving the proven 9x512 reverse-tail path while reducing the mismatch between low staged training gain and full-gain exact eval. This is a compact follow-up to the close capped-profile misses and changes no data paths, validation path, or export budget.
title: Mid-Capped Reverse-Tail Eval Profile
